iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.label: Label

iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.webspace_theme_in: Select the theme to use for this webspace
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.typography_assign: Sizes in rem, line heights as unitless ratio
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.variants_info: Define color variants for content blocks
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_clickParentP: Allow navigation to pages that have submenus
Adds a link to the parent page as first item in each submenu
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_transparentN: Removes the navbar background for a floating effect
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_scrollBg_inf: The transparent navbar takes its background color once the page is scrolled, and turns transparent again at the top
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_scrollHide_i: Hides the navbar when scrolling down, reveals it again when scrolling up
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_fullscreenIm: When set, the menu opens in two parts (image left, navigation right) with a curtain effect
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_twoColumns_i: Display navigation links in 2 columns (recommended with many submenus)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_sidebarPosit: Choose whether the sidebar appears on the left or right
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title: Title
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title_info: Section title of the block, rendered as an H2 by default. Avoid adding another heading of the same level in the text editor below.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.subtitle: Subtitle
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title_level_info: HTML semantic level of the title. Keep H2 unless another block already carries the section's main title (SEO / accessibility).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block.article_lis: Select the articles to display in the list
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block.article_car: Select the articles to display in the carousel
Duration between each slide in milliseconds
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block.article_fea: Hero: 1 article displayed. Side by side: 2 articles. Spotlight: 3 articles (1 main + 2 secondary).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.form_twig_templat: Path to the Twig template to include (e.g. forms/contact.html.twig)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.author: Author
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.center_icon_info: Only used when center text is empty.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.mega_source_info: Choose between automatic navigation or manual structure via snippet
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.hero_imag: Main image displayed at the top of the article
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.subtitle: Subtitle
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.additiona: The primary author is set in the article settings. Add co-authors or contributors here.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.related_a: Automatically fetched or manually selected related articles
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.event_is_: Check if this event takes place online (hides physical location)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.event_loc: Link to the online event platform (Zoom, Teams, etc.)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_back_t: Image from the media library (SVG recommended). Overrides the icon chosen above.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_sectio: Colors applied by default to every component (filter sidebar, pagination, breadcrumb, cards…) unless they are set individually in their own section below. Leave a field empty for a color computed automatically from the theme (works in both light and dark).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_filter: Applies filters as soon as a box is ticked or the sort changes (search after a short pause), with no "Apply" button and no page reload. When off, the visitor ticks several filters then clicks "Apply" — filtering is still reload-free.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.accessory_youtube: The ID is in the video URL after v= (e.g. dQw4w9WgXcQ)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.accessory_vimeo_i: The ID is in the video URL (e.g. 76979871)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.accessory_counter: Suffix shown next to the number (%, +, k, M)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.image_padding_inf: The margin is applied automatically when an image radius is configured (so the rounded corners stay visible).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.mobile_image_posi: On larger screens the position is controlled by the 'Image position' / 'Content on the right' settings.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_sectio: Interactive maps used by the Location block, the CTA location accessory and the form location widget. The tile provider attribution is always displayed (OpenStreetMap/Carto requirement). Leave colors empty to inherit them from the theme.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_maps_c: Tile server URL template, e.g. https://tile.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png (an API key goes directly in the URL). Where to find tile URLs: leaflet-extras.github.io/leaflet-providers/preview (interactive preview of dozens of free providers) and wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Raster_tile_providers (full list with usage terms). API-key providers (high traffic, premium styles): MapTiler, Stadia Maps, Thunderforest, Mapbox.
Attribution text displayed on the map (HTML allowed). Make sure to comply with your tile provider's terms.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_maps_m: Replaces the default pin with an image from the media library (PNG or SVG, ideally with the tip at the bottom center). The marker color is ignored in that case.
